description: Re-style or transform an existing video using Aleph 2.0. MODEL: aleph2 (only option). 28 credits/sec (56 credit minimum). Input video must be 30 seconds or shorter. WORKFLOW: Returns task_id → poll or use wait_for_runway_task.

reference_image.description: Optional guidance image, applied as a keyframe at the start of the video.

video.description: Source video (max 30s). HTTPS URL, Runway URI, or local file path.
